chapter_note: Chapter is dominated by correspondential-anthropological teaching about the three icons (pneumatic, psychic, somatic) in the righteous/elect person. This is cosmic structure mapped onto the human composite — classic correspondential anthropology with the New Man, Old Man, Mind of Light, Living Soul, and Virgin of Light all present. Heavy lacunae (80% damage). The "elect man" terminology in segment 4 is institutional vocabulary but appears within the substrate teaching about cosmic-anthropological structure. Only segment 3 is pure apostolic dialogue frame. Editorial fatigue score is mild; the second-half ecclesial drift is minimal and tied to the virtue list (faith, agape).
